description: Export a matter's issued invoices, advance invoices and credit notes (drafts and void invoices excluded) as a spreadsheet, an accounting import file (POHODA, Money S3, ABRA Flexi, ESO9), ISDOC, UBL (EN 16931) or Polish KSeF FA(3) e-invoices, or a LEDES 1998B e-billing file. Pass invoiceIds to export a selection; one export holds at most 500 invoices. Refused when a format cannot hold the data, e.g. Money S3 or ISDOC for an invoice outside the seller's home currency, or KSeF FA(3) for a credit note. Returns a short-lived downloadUrl, fileName and expiresAt; hand the URL to the user without reading the file bytes.

format.description: xlsx: one row per invoice; xlsx_lines: one row per invoice line; pohoda, money_s3, flexibee: accounting import XML; isdoc: ISDOC 6.0.2; ubl: UBL 2.1 e-invoices per EN 16931; ksef_fa3: Polish KSeF FA(3) e-invoices (isdoc, ubl and ksef_fa3 are a zip for several invoices); eso9: ESO9 import sheet; ledes_1998b: LEDES 1998B e-billing file

invoiceIds.description: Issued invoices to export; omit to export every issued invoice in the matter
